critical_bugs.root_cause: snapshot() omits 'side' column required by NOT NULL constraint on trades table
critical_bugs.expected: Trade row written to DB with lifecycle trade_id
critical_bugs.actual: 0 rows written, silent failure via WARNING log
critical_bugs.impact: Lifecycle in-memory state lost on restart. Identity maps empty after restart.

critical_bugs.root_cause: Two independent uuid4() calls create different IDs for the same logical trade
critical_bugs.actual: lifecycle.trade_id (uuid4-A) differs from position.position_id (uuid4-B). DB uses position_id. Lifecycle uses trade_id.
critical_bugs.impact: Split-brain identity. After restart, restore_from_db() creates trades with position_id as trade_id, not lifecycle trade_id.
critical_bugs.reproduction: Create trade, compare lifecycle.trade_id with position.position_id — different UUIDs

critical_bugs.root_cause: lifecycle.close_trade() called with gross_pnl=0.0, charges=0.0, net_pnl=0.0
critical_bugs.expected: Actual P&L from TradeCloseManager passed to lifecycle
critical_bugs.impact: API /api/trades returns net_pnl=0.0 for lifecycle trades
critical_bugs.reproduction: Close trade, check lifecycle trade net_pnl — always 0.0

critical_bugs.root_cause: New trade created via create_trade_from_signal() with signal.trigger_price, not the exit_price of old trade
critical_bugs.expected: New trade entry_price = old trade exit_price
critical_bugs.actual: New trade entry_price = 0.0 (trigger_price from signal, not execution price)
critical_bugs.impact: Reversal trade has wrong entry_price for P&L calculation
critical_bugs.reproduction: Reverse trade, check new trade entry_price — 0.0

acceptance_criteria.entry_trigger_behavior: PASS (HIGH break LONG, LOW break SHORT)
acceptance_criteria.reversal_behavior: PASS (atomic close+open, same signal links both)
acceptance_criteria.websocket_rest_reconciliation: PASS (WS for LTP, REST for candles)

status_reason: 2 P0 failures (FAIL-TL-001 lifecycle persist broken, SPLIT-BRAIN identity divergence) and 2 P1 failures (OBS-003 lifecycle P&L always 0.0, REVERSAL-ENTRY-PRICE new trade entry_price=0.0) prevent VERIFIED status. The core trading logic (TradeCloseManager, paper_broker, position_manager) works correctly. The lifecycle layer has persistence and identity issues that need fixing.
